rates.merchants: Hotels participating in IHG One Rewards

rates.note: Airline tickets purchased directly with the airline.
Excludes IHG hotels (10X). Purchases posted by 12/31/2026; other travel earns 3X after.

benefits.name: Anniversary free night
benefits.notes: Anniversary Free Night certificate at IHG hotels up to 50,000 points per night (top-up with points allowed).

benefits.name: Airline credit
benefits.notes: $100 statement credit once per calendar year after a single $250+ flight purchase directly with an airline.

benefits.name: IHG food & beverage reward
benefits.notes: $25 food & beverage reward deposited into your IHG One Rewards account each quarter for use at IHG hotels; expires at quarter end.

benefits.name: United TravelBank cash
benefits.notes: $25 United TravelBank cash deposited around Jan 5 and Jul 5 each year (Jan-Jun deposit expires Jul 15, Jul-Dec deposit expires Jan 15); link your MileagePlus account.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.notes: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: $10 credit loaded into your Instacart+ account each month; requires an active Instacart+ membership (3 months complimentary, then paid) and an order paid with the card. Unused credit expires at month end.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter if DashPass was first activated with the card 2/1/2025-8/31/2026; activations 9/1/2026-12/31/2027 get it each calendar month instead. Runs through 12/31/2027.

benefits.name: 15K bonus points after $15K spend
benefits.notes: 15,000 bonus points plus 5 Elite Night Credits after $15,000 in purchases each calendar year (on top of the 2 ENC earned per $5,000 spent).

benefits.name: Platinum Elite after $15K spend
benefits.notes: Platinum Elite status through December 31 of the following year after $15,000 in purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: Diamond Elite after $40K spend
benefits.notes: Diamond Elite status through December 31 of the following year after $40,000 in purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: Automatic Gold Elite status
benefits.notes: Gold Elite status for as long as you are a Premier cardmember.

benefits.name: 15 Elite Night Credits each year
benefits.notes: 15 Elite Night Credits at account opening, then deposited by Feb 1 each calendar year while the account is open. Also 2 ENC per $5,000 spent (plus 5 ENC after $15,000, see spend perk).

benefits.name: 4th Reward Night free
benefits.notes: Every 4th night free on a consecutive 4+ night standard Reward Night stay at the same hotel; unlimited stays, no spend needed.
